integrity: A complete symbolic proof and independent finite signed-chain verifier are included; same-model scientific checks do not constitute independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime polygon sizes only. The p=5 quotient is a circle, and the p>=7 fundamental group and homology statements are separate. Does not classify composite orders or reflection quotients. General proof uses existing secondary-polytopal and lens-space theory; two finite chain computations are corroboration, not an infinite proof. Bibliographic priority beyond inspected literature remains uncertain.
title: Prime rotational quotients of associahedral spheres are weighted lens spaces
